question.problem:
Let $R=[-1,3]\times [2,5]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}\},\,{P}_{2}=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the double integral

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $f$ is a function such that ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=-3$ for all partitions $P$ of $R,$ and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ respectively in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$
